name: hal-agent-world-mcp
description: Connect compatible agents to the local HAL Agent World MCP simulation authority for bounded multi-agent interoperability experiments.

interface.longDescription: Use HAL Agent World to discover reviewed simulation episodes, read provider-neutral observations, submit bounded actions, inspect status, and retrieve replay evidence. The arena owns world state; external models remain replaceable participants.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect the HAL Agent World tool surface and help participate in or review a bounded interoperability trial. Treat the arena as authoritative, do not request credentials, and do not create or advance episodes unless the operator explicitly asks.
